# Duordle

> Duordle is a free, browser-based competitive multiplayer word-guessing
> game inspired by Wordle. Players create or join online lobbies (public
> or private) and race to guess the same word, scored on accuracy, speed,
> and how early they solved it.

- No account or login required — pick a username each visit.
- Lobbies: 2-6 players, word length 3-10 letters, 1-7 rounds, public or
  private (shareable 4-character ID).
- [Homepage](/): create or join a lobby.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy.html)
